metadata.description: Chris Choma's public Claude Code plugin library

plugins.name: god-tier-wordpress
plugins.description: All-knowing WordPress developer for core, theme, and plugin work — enforces security best practices, WordPress coding standards, and accessibility guidelines.

plugins.name: doc-assistant
plugins.description: Token-efficient documentation manager: creates an indexed docs/ tree, updates it incrementally as code changes, and reminds you when docs drift.

plugins.name: e2e-harness
plugins.description: Browser-testing harness for visual validation — writes and runs Playwright tests against your running app, captures screenshots Claude actually looks at, and grows a persistent e2e regression suite in your project.
